scope: Backend configuration and validation for independent relay policy sources only.
intended_behavior: Backend config exposes independent semantic relay sources for service publish/backfill, public browser bootstrap/read, and ContextVM request/reply relay policy.
nostr.relays remains a backward-compatible backend/service alias and is not repurposed as public browser policy.
nostr.service_relays is the canonical backend service publish/backfill source and overrides the legacy alias when configured.
nostr.contextvm_relays is an explicit ContextVM request/reply source; when absent, resolved ContextVM policy falls back to browser relays without mutating the configured source.
Legacy private mirror relay fields remain rejected from YAML and environment configuration.

AUTH-unavailable behavior is fixed to exclude_and_fail so consumers exclude auth-required relays without credentials, surface relay reasons, and fail deterministically if remaining relays cannot satisfy success rules.
out_of_scope: NIP-51 relay-set projection and publication changes for bahia-8epx.3
Operator CLI discovery fallback for bahia-8epx.6
